in_use_evidence: No story or code at 2ed84b9 encodes it; ST-0003B (publication) is status draft and has no publication code on dev. No story names a Task or Folder called root.
why: The Scenario expects two holders of one name in one Folder, so a test written from it fails against a correct implementation and the implementer cannot satisfy it and the Scenario in the same Rule.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 2ed84b9 encodes the withdrawal reset; ST-0003B says the cut-back model is not built yet and no runs_until code exists on dev.
why: Withdrawing a retirement empties the end of a cut-back version that a prepared move still needs, so the exclusion constraint refuses the write with no specified code.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 2ed84b9 holds these refusal codes (grep of backlog and packages finds none).
why: Spec and state machine disagree on whether lifecycle refusals or claims come first, so a test or client cannot know which single code a multi-failure publication returns without asking the stakeholder.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 2ed84b9 builds a Folder draft; only scripts/entity-model-to-miro.py lists the FOLDER_DRAFT entity name and does not encode the missing column. The second option (gaps report listing) is referenced by no story.
why: Two Scenarios publish a Folder with a chosen first day that FOLDER_DRAFT cannot hold, so they cannot be built from the spec.

in_use_evidence: ST-0003B-details.md (status draft, not done) restates RUNS_FROM_NOT_IN_FUTURE for a stale date; it does not link validation-rules.md and no code builds the decided rule.
why: The validation row answers every stale first day with RUNS_FROM_NOT_IN_FUTURE and TASK_DRAFT_INVALID has no status, so a follower reaches the wrong code and no acceptance test covers the decision.

in_use_evidence: ST-0003B (draft) copies start_state to TASK.state, the state-on-Task side; no story or code puts state on the Task Version, so no story builds the Scenario wording.
why: The Scenarios assert a state on the Task Version, which has no such column, so a test written from them asserts a column that does not exist.

in_use_evidence: No Gherkin runner or BDD tool in CI, pyproject, Makefile or pre-commit at 2ed84b9; only spec-lint (a factory line linter that, per the finding, accepts the file) reads it.
why: Or is no Gherkin keyword, so the official parser refuses the whole file and no Gherkin tool can read any Rule in it.
rule_gap: In use, case syntax: 'a tool outside the run reads that syntax' does not say whether a tolerant linter that reads the file but does not parse Gherkin counts.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at bd22e1d/5c4bd67 encodes the withdrawal rule; ST-0003B has no cut-back and no runs_until_set_by_folder_id exists in code.
why: Column comments, the Withdrawal row and the Scenario give a voided version its end back, which the proposal and the invariant forbid, so a correct implementation fails a test written from the row.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 8b83d00 holds FOLDER_* refusal codes or an End Folder Run; grep of backlog and packages finds none.
why: The spec says either code may answer a draft that fails two checks while DEC-44 and DEC-45 fix the order, so a test cannot assert one code.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 8b83d00 builds the needed-values or fill check; task_registry/validators.py treats run_as as optional but does not encode a needed-values rule, and ST-0003B restates only REQUIRED content fields.
why: Three checks rest on 'every value a Task needs' that no artifact lists, so an implementer cannot decide whether a Task without priority publishes without asking the stakeholder.
rule_gap: In use cases 4 to 7: the validator treats run_as as optional and the open ST-0003B lists REQUIRED fields, so other-side, open-story and none all fit a missing definition.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 8b83d00 holds Folder lifecycle requests, RIGHT_MISSING or FOLDER_INVALID_TRANSITION (grep finds none).
why: Two rows both refuse a state change on the root Folder with no stated order, so the FLD-02 Scenario cannot be asserted.

in_use_evidence: ST-0003B-details.md (draft) refuses a missing name as a draft content failure, the DEC-46 side; no story or code builds the pseudocode behavior that publishes a nameless draft.
why: Both the pseudocode and the prose send a draft without a name to publication or to TASK_VALUE_UNRESOLVED, so an implementation that follows the state machine fails the FLD-08 Scenario.

in_use_evidence: Code and ST-0003B (done) build no config_hash column and a nullable dispatch_target, the entity-model side; ST-0003B only links T-0051 to T-0054 as deferrals, so no story or code builds what T-0052 and T-0054 say.
why: T-0052 to T-0054 tell a planner to add a hash column and a required dispatch target that the entity model replaced, so a planner who cuts stories from them builds the wrong schema.

in_use_evidence: definition_store_service.py _require_publishable_drafts (line 310) on dev, merged into the branch before 59b6757, returns one problem per field error and test_publication_routes.py:316 asserts REQUIRED twice; ST-0003B is done.
